blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Wednesday denied allegations of selective law enforcement after social media posts circulated claiming that police officers would not arrest protesters identified as members of the Iglesia ni Cristo (INC). The posts featured text messages allegedly instructing police officers not to arrest INC members participating in rallies. NCRPO chief Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano said the police do not grant favors based on “religious affiliation, political beliefs, or organizational membership.” He also warned the public against misleading information regarding the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits.
